title: Unexplained hitch
description: A 96 ms hitch with every observable metric flat. The correct answer is that the cause cannot be determined, with the exclusions listed.

events.title: Unexplained
events.whatHappened: One frame took 96 ms against a 6.9 ms baseline. 7 possible causes were checked and ruled out.
events.mechanism: Frame timing was disturbed, but none of the causes FrameDoctor can observe changed around it. This is consistent with work inside the game itself — shader compilation, asset streaming, or a driver hitch — which is not visible in system-level counters.

ruledOut.title: Background CPU contention
ruledOut.reason: Total CPU load did not rise materially (peak 43%).

ruledOut.title: CPU frequency collapse
ruledOut.reason: CPU effective clock stayed near 4.61 GHz.

ruledOut.title: GPU thermal throttling
ruledOut.reason: GPU peaked at 67 C with no thermal limit reported.

ruledOut.title: GPU power limit
ruledOut.reason: The GPU reported nothing as the reason for its clocks.

ruledOut.title: Storage stall
ruledOut.reason: Disk response time stayed at 0.4 ms.

ruledOut.title: Driver interrupt latency
ruledOut.reason: Kernel-mode time stayed at 0.6% (deferred calls and interrupts).
